name: dpr
notes: Owns daily progress reports, their task updates and material notes. A supervisor (scoped to the project) or an office role with dpr.report.create writes one report per project per date; the date follows the kernel backdating rule. Submitting needs 10 characters of work done and, while the setting dpr_photo_required is on, a photo (files of entity type dpr_report, at most 20). On submit the task percents move through projects.updateTaskProgress; lowering a percent needs a note. The project manager reviews or reopens a submitted report; a reviewed report is final. getMissingDprs lists active projects with a supervisor on the date and no submitted or reviewed report (read view dpr_v_submission_status); from 18:00 Asia/Karachi the scheduler tick tells each project manager once per day (dpr_missing_runs), except on days in the setting site_holidays. Manpower comes from the manual field until attendance (P1-17) exists to read counts from (see BACKLOG). It posts no costs and changes no attendance.
